lemma chain_binding:
  all-traces
  "∀ ds_token us_token broker idp user #i.
    (Chain_Binding( ds_token, us_token, broker, idp, user ) @ #i) ⇒
    (∃ idp_pk idp_issuer #j.
      (US_Signature_Verified( broker, idp, us_token, idp_pk, idp_issuer
       ) @ #j) ∧
      (#j < #i))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ ds_token us_token broker idp user #i.
  (Chain_Binding( ds_token, us_token, broker, idp, user ) @ #i)
 ∧
  ∀ idp_pk idp_issuer #j.
   (US_Signature_Verified( broker, idp, us_token, idp_pk, idp_issuer ) @ #j)
  ⇒
   ¬(#j < #i)"
*/
by sorry
